name: Blood's Cry for Vengeance (Assamite Sorcery, Level Two Ritual)

system.description:
This ritual links two or more willing participants in a subtle psychic bond. Under ordinary circumstances it has no detectable effect, but if any linked member dies, all others instantly experience a vision of her fall and a flash of her emotional state at death (letting them know if she died honorably or was betrayed). Every loyal Assamite is bound to the clan's Eldest by this ritual upon her first pilgrimage to Alamut.

Each individual to be linked, up to a maximum equal to the caster's Occult rating, donates two Blood Traits into a wooden bowl. Over the following hour the caster boils the blood over an open fire while the participants meditate on their bonds; when the blood has boiled away the ritual is complete. A successful casting permanently links all participants as described — the knowledge of death is transmitted instantly and cannot be blocked by any known means. There is no limit to how many circles a single Assamite may belong to.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
